faq.heroLead: Find answers to common questions about OMDALA, verified coordination, and how to get involved.

questions.question: What is OMDALA?
questions.answer: OMDALA is an independent platform for verified real-world coordination. It provides the infrastructure for people, places, resources, and execution to connect in a trustable way.

questions.question: How does verification work?
questions.answer: Participants make commitments, execute actions, and attach verifiable proof. The network validates these proofs and updates trust scores accordingly.

questions.question: Who can use OMDALA?
questions.answer: Anyone — individuals, experts, hosts, communities, and organizations can participate in verified coordination networks.

questions.question: Is OMDALA free?
questions.answer: Basic coordination features are available. Premium features and advanced verification capabilities may require a subscription.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Create an account on app.omdala.com, set up your profile, and start exploring coordination opportunities in your area.
